content.text:
Server works correctly. Set up in `hook/rep3/`:

- **`package.json`** — minimal manifest, no dependencies needed (uses only Node's built-in `http`)
- **`statusCodes.js`** — `STATUS_CODES` lookup table (code → reason phrase) plus a `getReasonPhrase(code)` helper
- **`server.js`** — HTTP server exposing `GET /statuses` (full table) and `GET /statuses/:code` (single lookup)

Run it with `npm start` (or `node server.js`, `PORT` env var optional, defaults to 3000).
